description: Return free-to-play games, which cost nothing to play, most reviewed on Steam first. Use it when the reader wants something free; for paid games within a budget use find_games, and for discounts list_deals. `genre` (a Steam genre) and `platform` (pc, xbox, playstation or switch) narrow the list and combine; `total` is the full count, which can exceed `limit`. There are no prices and no promoted placements. The result also says where signed-in members claim the time-limited free-to-keep giveaways, which are not listed here. Each game links to its page on getcheapgames.com.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

genre.description: A Steam genre, spelled as Steam spells it: Action, Adventure, Casual, Indie, Massively Multiplayer, Racing, RPG, Simulation, Sports or Strategy. Any other value matches nothing.

platform.description: Only keys for this platform: pc, xbox, playstation or switch. Omit for all.

name: list_free_to_play
title: Suggest free-to-play games
